profile.languages: Arabic (official), French (lingua franca), Tamazight (official) (dialects include Kabyle (Taqbaylit), Shawiya (Tacawit), Mzab, Tuareg (Tamahaq))
profile.religions: Muslim (official; predominantly Sunni) 99%, other (includes Christian, Jewish, Ahmadi Muslim, Shia Muslim, Ibadi Muslim) <1% (2012 est.)
profile.legalSystem: mixed system of French civil law and Islamic law; judicial review of legislative acts in ad hoc Constitutional Council composed of various public officials including several Supreme Court justices
profile.nationalHoliday: Independence Day, 5 July (1962); Revolution Day, 1 November (1954)
profile.location: Northern Africa, bordering the Mediterranean Sea, between Morocco and Tunisia
